remarks: Spacious and beautifully updated 1BR/1BA residence located on the 7th floor of the sought-after Hayes House Condominiums in Stamford's desirable Strawberry Hill neighborhood. This light-filled unit features an expansive open-concept living and dining area with stunning herringbone-style flooring, oversized windows, and sliders leading to a large private balcony with peaceful treetop and skyline views. The updated galley kitchen offers white cabinetry, subway tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, modern fixtures, generous storage, and a separate pantry area. The oversized bedroom easily accommodates a king-sized bed and includes excellent closet space, while the updated bathroom features clean timeless finishes. Multiple closets throughout provide exceptional storage rarely found in a one-bedroom unit. Hayes House offers 24-hour concierge/security, fitness center, community room, laundry facilities, garage parking, storage locker, and beautifully maintained courtyard areas. Heat, hot water, and air conditioning are included in the common charges. Conveniently located just minutes to downtown Stamford, Metro-North, shopping, dining, and major highways.
